title: 第4623章 一枚令牌第4622章 一具干尸
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 唐天沉默片刻，再次看向干尸手掌间那枚暗沉物件。
虽然只是匆匆一瞥，但他已经看清了那东西的轮廓。
是一枚令牌状的东西，边缘有细密的纹路。
干尸的手掌微微蜷曲着，仿佛在死前最后一刻还在用力握着那枚令牌。
唐天想了想，没有再去碰棺材。
而是往后退了一步，绕着石棺重新走了一圈，目光一寸一寸扫过棺身四周。
这次他注意到石棺底部，贴近地面的位置。
有一道很浅的刻痕，几乎完全被灰尘掩盖。
他蹲下身吹开表面的灰，那道刻痕完整地显露出来，是一行非常小的字。
“此物不可带入封印之上，不可与气血同处一地，否则封印必破。”
字迹和棺盖凹槽边缘的光膜一样老，像是写在很多年前，写完就再也没有人看过。
唐天站起身，将那行字默念了一遍。
他转头看向石棺内干尸手掌间那枚令牌，又低头看了看自己指尖残留的灰白色粉末。
然后他没再犹豫，直接转身走向了来路。
他没有去拿那枚令牌。
不论那枚令牌是什么，既然刻痕上写明了不能和气血同处一处，那他带着精血进去之前，绝不能碰那东西。
他走出岔路口的时候，回头看了一眼。
圆形空间里的白光还是那么明亮，石棺安安静静地待在正中央，像是从未被打扰过。
他转身朝另一条通道走去。
岔路口另一条通道比左边那条窄得多，勉强够一个人侧身通过。
走进去大约十几步之后，两侧墙壁上那些晶石消失了……
取而代之的是一层暗沉的光泽，像是墙壁本身在缓慢地呼吸。
唐天伸手摸了一下，墙面的触感温热，和外面的冰冷石壁截然不同。
他加快脚步，在弯曲狭窄的通道中穿行。
大约走了一炷香的时间，前方忽然开阔起来，通道的尽头连着一片巨大的地底空间。
那片空间很高也很深，像一座被倒扣在地底的穹顶。
穹顶中央悬挂着一团灰白色的光团，光芒不刺眼，却将整个空间照得一片通明。
光团下方是一片平整的石台，石台正中央摆放着一个巴掌大的黑色盒子。
和他之前拿到的那只黑石盒子几乎一模一样，但颜色更深，表面也没有任何纹路。
唐天站在通道边缘没有急着上前。
他先仔细观察了一会儿，确认那片空间里没有其他机关或禁制，才迈步走上石台。
靠近那个黑色盒子的时候，他注意到石台表面，刻着一圈很浅的环形纹路。
纹路延伸到盒子底部，像是将盒子固定在正中央的。
他蹲下身，用手指沿着那圈环形纹路摸了一圈。
纹路并不深，但触感冰凉，和他之前摸到的石壁完全不同。
他想了想，没有直接碰那个黑色盒子，而是取出混沌珠放在石台边缘。
混沌珠的光芒照在黑色盒子上，盒子的表面慢慢浮现出一层极淡的暗灰色光晕。
那光晕持续了大约三个呼吸，然后像被风吹散一样缓缓消失了。
唐天从混沌珠中取出那滴青色精血，将血珠托在掌心，靠近黑色盒子。
精血的光芒，和盒子表面的暗灰色光晕接触的瞬间，盒子发出了一声极轻的嗡鸣。
content_en:
Tang Tian was silent for a moment and looked at the dark object in the palm of the mummy again.
Although it was only a quick glance, he could already see the outline of the thing clearly.
It is a token-shaped thing with fine lines on the edge.
The palm of the mummy was slightly curled, as if it was still holding the token tightly at the last moment before death.
Tang Tian thought for a while and didn't touch the coffin again.
Instead, he took a step back and walked around the sarcophagus again, scanning the surroundings of the coffin inch by inch.
This time he noticed the bottom of the sarcophagus, close to the ground.
There was a very shallow scratch, almost completely covered by dust.
He knelt down and blew away the dust on the surface, and the scratch was completely revealed, which was a line of very small words.
"This object cannot be brought above the seal, and cannot be placed in the same place with Qi and blood, otherwise the seal will be broken."
The handwriting is as old as the light film on the edge of the groove on the coffin lid, as if it was written many years ago and no one has read it since.
Tang Tian stood up and recited the words silently.
He turned to look at the token in the palm of the mummy in the sarcophagus, and then looked down at the gray-white powder remaining on his fingertips.
Then without any further hesitation, he turned around and walked towards the way he came from.
He didn't go to get the token.
No matter what the token was, since the mark stated that it could not be in the same place with Qi and blood, he must not touch that thing before entering with the blood and essence.
When he walked out of the fork in the road, he looked back.
The white light in the circular space was still so bright, and the sarcophagus stayed quietly in the center, as if it had never been disturbed.
He turned and walked towards another passage.
The other passage at the fork in the road is much narrower than the one on the left, barely enough for a person to pass sideways.
After walking in for about ten steps, the crystal stones on the walls on both sides disappeared...
Instead there was a dull sheen, as if the wall itself was slowly breathing.
Tang Tian reached out and touched it. The wall felt warm to the touch, which was completely different from the cold stone wall outside.
He quickened his pace and walked through the winding and narrow passages.
After walking for about a stick of incense, the front suddenly opened up, and the end of the passage was connected to a huge underground space.
The space was very high and deep, like a dome that was turned upside down underground.
A ball of gray-white light hangs in the center of the dome. The light is not dazzling, but it illuminates the entire space.
Below the light group is a flat stone platform, with a palm-sized black box placed in the center of the stone platform.
It was almost identical to the black stone box he got before, but the color was darker and there were no lines on the surface.
Tang Tian stood at the edge of the passage and did not rush forward.
He observed carefully for a while to confirm that there were no other mechanisms or restrictions in that space, and then stepped onto the stone platform.
When he approached the black box, he noticed that there was a very light circular pattern carved on the surface of the stone platform.
The pattern extends to the bottom of the box, as if fixing the box in the center.
He knelt down and traced the circular pattern with his fingers.
The lines were not deep, but it felt cold to the touch, completely different from the stone walls he had touched before.
He thought for a moment and did not touch the black box directly. Instead, he took out the Chaos Bead and placed it on the edge of the stone platform.
The light of the Chaos Orb shone on the black box, and a very faint dark gray halo slowly appeared on the surface of the box.
The halo lasted for about three breaths, and then slowly disappeared as if blown away by the wind.
Tang Tian took out the drop of cyan blood essence from the Chaos Bead, held the blood bead in his palm, and approached the black box.
The moment the light of essence and blood came into contact with the dark gray halo on the surface of the box, the box made a very light buzz.
